title: Phase 1: 15 Rescue Rafts Deployed & 10,000 Rations Distributed
description:
# Deliverable Verification Report: Milestone #1

## 🛥️ Water Rescue Deployment
- **15 motorized shallow-draft rescue rafts** were procured and deployed across **Majuli Island (8 boats)** and **Cachar Barak River basin (7 boats)**.
- **Evacuation Results**: 2,840 stranded residents safely evacuated to dry highland relief camps.

## 🍞 Emergency Food Distribution
- **10,000 family survival ration packets** distributed across 14 relief camps.
- Each packet contained: 5kg flattened rice (chira), 2kg jaggery, 20 packets ORS, 50 halogen water purification tablets, high-calorie biscuits, and baby nutrition.

## 🧾 Supporting Documents & Evidence
- **Vendor Invoice**: Raft Manufacturer Receipt #BR-2026-891 ($12,000 USDC)
- **Food Supplier Challan**: Kamrup Wholesale Rations Challan #KW-104 ($8,000 USDC)
- **Government DDMA Endorsement**: Majuli Sub-Divisional Officer Acknowledgment Letter
